image_description: A close-up shot of a pale orange/cream-colored coral fungus (likely Ramaria or Clavulina species) growing on dark, decaying wood or forest floor debris. The fungus features a dense cluster of upright, cylindrical branches that divide repeatedly into finer tips. Green leaves are visible in the background, providing contrast. The lighting is natural, highlighting the texture of the fungal branches.
